test_title: PYST 80: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have all correct spellings. Choose the sentence with the incorrect spelt word / words.

options.text: Beyond the inky sea and far up that high, black shadow of a hill lived the Divers.
This preparation for bonds, and the additional igneminy it inferred, took a little of the excitement out of me.
Marner wanted the heaps of ten to grow into a square, and then into a larger square.
The judge said he could hug him for them words; so he cried, and his wife she cried again.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"igneminy"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"ignominy"**. (अपमान)

 
 
• **Example: **He faced the** ignominy** of being dismissed from his job.
 
 
 
• **"Ignominy"** refers to public shame or disgrace. (अपमान)
 
 
• **Example: **After the scandal, he lived in** ignominy.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1**: Beyond the inky sea and far up that high, black shadow of a hill lived the Divers. (इस वाक्य में कोई गलत वर्तनी नहीं है।)

 
 
• **Example:** He lived beyond the inky sea for many years.
 
 
 
• **Option 3**: Marner wanted the heaps of ten to grow into a square, and then into a larger square. (इस वाक्य में कोई गलत वर्तनी नहीं है।)
 
 
• **Example:** Heaps of ten grew into a larger square.
 
 
 
• **Option 4**: The judge said he could hug him for them words; so he cried, and his wife she cried again. (इस वाक्य में कोई गलत वर्तनी नहीं है।)
 
 
• **Example:** The judge said he could hug him for them words.
 
 

35:Te17,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
